overview: This paper proposes SPECS, a three-stage framework that decouples multimodal learning by using self-distilled preference data and DPO for cold start to learn output formats, followed by GRPO for deep reasoning, while introducing the Generalization Factor (GF) to quantify model generalization.

modules.name: Generalization Factor Metric
modules.description: Implements the calculation of the Generalization Factor (GF) metric, which computes the F-beta score based on the performance gains of a model on in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks compared to a baseline model, quantifying generalization capability.

modules.name: Self-Distillation Data Engine
modules.description: Orchestrates the generation of preference data by prompting both the GRPO-zero exploratory model and the base model, collecting responses that share the same question but differ in reasoning paradigm and format.

modules.name: Rejected Response Pollution Strategy
modules.description: Implements the format corruption logic for generating rejected responses. This includes strategies such as removing specific structural tags, moving tag positions, or replacing tags with plain text strings to ensure a clear learning signal for format discrimination.

modules.name: Hybrid DPO-SFT Loss
modules.description: Defines the custom loss function for the cold-start phase, combining the standard Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) loss with a Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) negative log-likelihood loss on chosen responses, weighted by a balance coefficient.

modules.name: Composite RL Reward Function
modules.description: Implements the reward mechanism for the final GRPO fine-tuning stage, combining a format reward (assessing structural tag correctness) and an accuracy reward (using rule-based evaluation for objective types and LLM-based evaluation for subjective types).

modules.name: Preference Dataset Construction
modules.description: Manages the creation and collation of the self-distilled preference dataset, handling the pairing of filtered chosen responses with polluted rejected responses and structuring the data for DPO training.

modules.name: Chosen Response Filtration
modules.description: Integrates an external LLM judge to verify the consistency between the reasoning steps and the final answer in the chosen responses generated by the GRPO-zero model, filtering out cases of reward hacking or inconsistent logic.

modules.name: Multimodal VLM Data Loader
modules.description: Handles the loading and batching of multimodal data (image and text), applying specific tokenization and image transformations required by the vision-language model, and supporting different prompt formats for ID and OOD generalization tests.

modules.name: GRPO Trainer
modules.description: Implements the Group Relative Policy Optimization training loop used in Stage 1 (to generate the exploratory GRPO-zero model) and Stage 3 (final reasoning fine-tuning), handling rollout generation, advantage calculation, and policy updates.

modules.name: DPO Trainer
modules.description: Implements the Direct Preference Optimization training loop for the cold-start phase, managing the reference model, calculating the hybrid DPO-SFT loss, and updating the policy to align with format preferences.

modules.name: Multi-Stage Pipeline Orchestrator
modules.description: Controls the execution flow of the three-stage SPECS framework, managing the transition from Stage 1 (GRPO-zero training) to Stage 2 (DPO cold start) and finally to Stage 3 (GRPO fine-tuning), ensuring correct model inheritance between stages.

modules.name: Multimodal Benchmark Evaluator
modules.description: Executes the evaluation pipeline on various multimodal benchmarks (e.g., MEGA-Bench, MMMU, MathVista), handling inference, answer extraction, and accuracy calculation against ground truth.

modules.name: RL Exploration Metrics
modules.description: Calculates metrics to assess the exploration capability and performance potential of the model during training, specifically implementing Pass@K evaluation and the Rollout Branching Factor (RBF) to measure generation diversity.

modules.name: LLM-as-Judge Integration
modules.description: Provides a utility module to query proprietary LLMs (like GPT-4o) for evaluating subjective short-answer questions during RL reward calculation and for verifying reasoning consistency during data filtration.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Configures and runs comparative experiments to validate key design choices, including comparing self-distillation versus external teacher distillation, decoupled versus coupled preference data, and DPO-based versus SFT-based cold starts.

modules.name: Prompt & Format Configuration
modules.description: Manages the system prompts and structural tag definitions used across different stages and evaluation settings (e.g., ừng/think and <answer> tags for training vs. <cot> and <response> tags for OOD evaluation).

modules.name: Experiment Tracker & Checkpoint Manager
modules.description: Handles the logging of training metrics (loss, rewards, GF values), monitoring of policy stability, and the saving/loading of model checkpoints at the end of each pipeline stage to ensure reproducibility.
